Every linear subspace of the 3 × 3 matrices over 𝔽₃ of dimension at least six contains a nonzero
nilpotent matrix, so Conjecture 8 of Y. Wigderson (arXiv:2609.29177) fails for F = 𝔽₃ and n = 3; the
largest dimension of a nilpotent-free subspace is five. The conjecture holds for n ≤ 2 over every
finite field and for n = 3 over 𝔽₂ and 𝔽₅.

Attached: the paper (PDF), its LaTeX source with the figures as PNG, and the arXiv tarball. The
repository contains the Lean 4 proof with Mathlib (all sixteen main theorems; trust base: the
standard axioms and, for the search, the Lean compiler), the C, C++ and Python checks, and the dated
priority check.
